summary: Verified Apify webhook receiver behaves correctly after secret rotation. All 8 backend tests passed (3 negative auth, 3 positive auth via header/Bearer/query, idempotent import, /api/listings sanity). The old rotated secret is properly rejected (401) across all three delivery methods; the new secret is accepted; and the ingest is idempotent (2 created on first POST, 2 updated on repeat).
critical_code_review_comments: _authorize_webhook uses hmac.compare_digest correctly (constant-time) and fails closed when APIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset (503). Good.
products.py is 658 lines — consider splitting normalization helpers into a separate module if it grows further.
Idempotent upsert keyed on sku/source_url with $setOnInsert for id/created_at is correct — preserves original id + is_active on update.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_ prefixed products created via webhook using unique per-run ASINs (B00TEST<hex>A/B). These persist in products collection (permanent by design).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Webhook secret rotation verified end-to-end. Test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_webhook_rotation.py can be re-run as a regression check any time. /api/listings returned 200 with a valid list. Idempotent import creates on first call and updates on second (asserted via created/updated counts).
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Rotation was implemented correctly and the old secret is rejected.
